$schema: the WS-17 §8 sign-off matrix — see packages/core/test/conformance/ws17-signoff.test.ts for the cite-or-cover gate

rows.title: Real model-emitted `SendMessage` through the TS alias reaches `mcp__winter__send_message` with native args and returns the visible result (item 1)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table (owner: Lane B's alias handlers, with Lane A's toolAliases).

rows.title: `ListAgents` aliasing; canonical MCP duplicate deferred/hidden visibility; behavior without Tool Search (item 2)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table.

rows.title: `disallowedTools` + permission floor cover harness-internal/direct paths aliases miss (item 3)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table.

rows.title: Two official sessions under the spool: isolated discovery, delivery, hold/refuse, idle wake, zero visibility into `~/.claude` (item 4)
rows.note: PARTIAL — proven halves (8d + 9a): two official sessions, one spool — isolated discovery, delivery (SendMessage A->B), a planted ~/.claude byte-identical, HOLD (queued, delivered into B's next request body) and REFUSE (not_found, isError) match the spec on the real 0.3.250 binary; crash mid-turn -> resumable, next send = generation 2, matches WS-16 §14. The idle-wake half is a measured GAP, not proven: a genuinely `resumable` official session is refused `unavailable` exactly like an exited one, because router 0.0.3 exposes no cold-resume path (WS-15 §6.2) — carried to router 0.0.4.

rows.title: Official parent resume after restart restores completed children for native SendMessage resume (item 5)
rows.note: PARTIAL — refusal branch only (8d): native SendMessage to a completed official child, across a directory restart, refuses `unavailable` (WS-15 §6.2 wording). Router 0.0.3 exposes no official cold-resume path, so the restore direction itself stays unmeasured — carried to router 0.0.4.

rows.title: Winter child identity + ResumeContext reconstructed after daemon restart (item 6)
rows.note: Proven 8b, re-confirmed 8d: a second registry over the same home reconstructs the child whole.

rows.title: Messaging: addressing, ambiguity/staleness, dedupe, queue bounds, TTL, retries, crash windows, loop prevention, reply routing, `notify_when_idle` (item 7)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table.

rows.title: Shared filesystem `SessionStore` + pinned dialect: Claude→Winter, Winter→Claude, and both round-trips at every advertised level (item 8)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table; the official producer leg is proven through the door's real-runtime bed.

rows.title: Capability matrix published across all axes, implemented vs correctly-unavailable distinguished (item 9)
rows.note: Partial as measured in 8d: Norma's mode × runtime × surface rows are generated and drift-pinned (packages/core/capability-matrix.json, P8d-15). The other axes of the matrix are the router/SDK repo's own obligation, not proven here.

rows.title: 0.3.251 / 0.3.252 (Claude Code 2.1.251/2.1.252) through the upgrade corpus before any pin change (item 10)
rows.note: Carried: the 0.3.251/0.3.252 upgrade-corpus obligation is standing, not 9c's to discharge. No pin change may land before it runs.

rows.title: Delete/rebuild of the disposable `sessions/index.db` preserves runtime mappings, backend IDs, cursors (item 11)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table.

rows.title: Documented message-size, 50-accepted/100-held queues, 5-minute dialog expiry, 12-hour idle subscription, permission-class behavior; inert `@` mentions retained (item 12)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table.

rows.title: No verbatim all-rights-reserved artifacts in the Winter distribution; ephemeral CI fetch only (item 13)
rows.note: The router's proof is scoped to its own distribution (the pinned package, its bundle, or a vendored copy — never tracked; the OPTIONAL peer named in a REACHABLE declaration is rejected). Separately, by the user's P9c-1 ruling: the Winter DISTRIBUTION (the `@yanlinglabs/winter-agent-sdk*` packages) carries no all-rights-reserved artifact, while the APP embeds the unmodified `claude` binary under Anthropic's published permission — `scripts/embed-runtimes.sh` VERIFIES (never re-signs) that embedded binary's Developer ID signature and hardened-runtime flag before every Release build.

rows.title: Native + aliased Agent/worktree, durable Cron, workflow, saved-approval, plan-mode, and arbitrary file/shell paths cannot create `CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/`, or `~/.claude/plans` under strict policy (item 14)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table, with a standing qualification: shell-escape spellings are caught post-hoc by the sweep, never pre-hoc.

rows.title: Canonical memory + the D18 temp layout `/private/tmp/winter-<uid>/<engine>-<uid>/<key>/<uuid>/{scratchpad,tasks}`; cross-engine temp continuity (Claude→Winter in-place adoption; Winter→Claude clone-copy at the barrier; round trip stabilizes in the claude engine dir); vendor temp roots reported honestly; supervised pre-cleanup reconciliation; default-spawn `mirror_error` handoff refusal; entire-adapter projection before any all-Winter-names claim; `$bunfs` extraction avoided or tested (item 15)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table; the official producer leg is proven through the door's real-runtime bed (hermetic, the four traffic opt-outs).

rows.title: Standalone SDK launches its packaged runtime without the app; the app consumes the identical versioned artifact (companion §12.9)
rows.note: PROVEN (9a): `@yanlinglabs/winter-agent-sdk-darwin-arm64@0.0.5` is on npm, built on a macOS arm64 runner from a path-neutral copy and published in lockstep with the wrapper, which pins the exact version as an optional dependency. The app's `stage-runtimes.ts` takes `winter` from the installed platform package (dual-hop resolution through the wrapper's own node_modules nesting; version-gated against REQUIRED_WINTER_AGENT_SDK). `release.ts`'s `row16IdentityCheck` requires the embedded pre-sign SHA-256 to equal the npm-shipped file's for a non-dry-run release (`--allow-checkout-winter` is the loud rehearsal escape); CI's verify job proves it without any SDK checkout.

rows.title: Two identical raw model IDs behind different providers keep distinct provider-qualified identity/credentials/continuation/resume routes (companion §12.10)
rows.note: Proven in the router's own conformance table.

rows.title: Declaration, request-schema, behavioral-trace, provider-adapter, TS package, core, protocol, and Swift client suites pass separately (item 16 / companion §12.11)
rows.note: Proven 8d, re-confirmed 9a: app-repo CI runs protocol, core, plugin-sdk, cli, typecheck ×2, codegen, Swift (WinterProtocol + WinterKit) and the three compiled proofs (workflow, runtime-state, runtimes) as separate jobs; the SDK repo adds a per-push macOS build-platform job.
